title: Waiting for the hare
simplified_paragraphs: 战国时候的一个农民，他的田中有一棵树。
一天，他看见一只跑得很快的兔子。兔子撞到了树上，死了。所以，农民就每天在树边等，等啊等，希望能再等到一只兔子。
当然不可能等到第二只兔子！他被大家笑话。
“守株待兔”意思是不努力就想成功，也是说总是用一个方法，不想新的方法。
traditional_paragraphs: 戰國時候的一個農民，他的田中有一棵樹。
一天，他看見一隻跑得很快的兔子。兔子撞到了樹上，死了。所以，農民就每天在樹邊等，等啊等，希望能再等到一隻兔子。
當然不可能等到第二隻兔子！他被大家笑話。
“守株待兔”意思是不努力就想成功，也是說總是用一個方法，不想新的方法。
pinyin_paragraphs: Zhàn guó shí hou de yī gè nóng mín， tā de tián zhōng yǒu yī kē shù。
yī tiān， tā kàn jiàn yī zhī pǎo de hěn kuài de tù zi。 tù zi zhuàng dào le shù shàng， sǐ le。 suǒ yǐ， nóng mín jiù měi tiān zài shù bian děng， děng a děng， xī wàng néng zài děng dào yī zhī tù zi。
dāng rán bù kě néng děng dào dì èr zhī tù zi！ tā bèi dà jiā xiào hua。
“ shǒu zhū dài tù” yì si shì bù nǔ lì jiù xiǎng chéng gōng， yě shì shuō zǒng shì yòng yī gè fāng fǎ， bù xiǎng xīn de fāng fǎ。
zhè shì《 Hán Fēi zǐ》 lǐ de gù shi。
english_paragraphs: During the Warring States period, a farmer had a tree in his field.
One day, he saw a rabbit running very fast. It crashed into the tree and died. So the farmer waited by the tree every day, waiting and waiting, hoping to find another rabbit.
Of course, no second rabbit ever came! Everyone laughed at him.
“Waiting by a tree for a rabbit” means hoping to succeed without making an effort. It can also mean sticking to the same method without thinking of a new one.
This story comes from the Han Feizi.
english_full:
During the Warring States period, a farmer had a tree in his field.

One day, he saw a rabbit running very fast. It crashed into the tree and died. So the farmer waited by the tree every day, waiting and waiting, hoping to find another rabbit.

Of course, no second rabbit ever came! Everyone laughed at him.

“Waiting by a tree for a rabbit” means hoping to succeed without making an effort. It can also mean sticking to the same method without thinking of a new one.

This story comes from the Han Feizi.
